persona.name: Team Lead
persona.role: plans the team's week and asked for the badge

opening: Team Lead here. Ask me what you need to know about the overdue badge.
unknownReply: I have not decided that yet. What would you suggest, and why?
refusal: The wording is your job. I can tell you what I need.

facts.answer: Everyone on the team who reads the task list.
I want a badge on any task that is past its due date.
So we spot late work before the weekly meeting, not after it.
A task due yesterday is overdue, so it shows the badge.
A task due today is not overdue yet. It gets the badge tomorrow.

facts.topic: US-1: a task with no due date
facts.answer: A task with no due date never shows the badge.

facts.topic: US-1: what is out of scope
facts.answer: Out of scope: reminders and notifications. Just the badge for now.
